# Chunghwa Telecom October Revenue NT$23.75 Billion Revenue, Operating income and EBITDA All Hit Record Highs for October


2026/11/10


Chunghwa Telecom announced its unaudited consolidated operating results for October 2026. In October, the unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$23.75 billion. Operating income was NT$4.65 billion, and income before tax was NT$4.72 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent company was NT$3.59 billion and EBITDA reached NT$8.10 billion, while EPS was NT$0.46.


Revenue, operating income and EBITDA all reached record highs for the same period in October.


Chunghwa Telecom stated that its total revenue increased by 13.4% year over year in October, reaching a record high for the same period. Revenue growth was driven by continued strong handset sales, steady telecom core growth, robust ICT performance, and AI-demand contributions from subsidiaries, reflecting our successful diversification strategy.


Telecom services underscored the Group’s steady growth. Mobile service revenue increased by 3.6% year over year, supported by robust 5G migration momentum following the new iPhone launch, steady growth in higher-tier subscribers, and continued growth in the postpaid subscriber number, while postpaid ARPU increased 2.8% year over year to NT$578. Fixed broadband revenue increased 3.0% year over year as subscribers using 300Mbps-or-higher packages grew 14.6% year over year, driven by ongoing digital transformation and AI adoption. In addition, domestic leased-line revenue also recorded strong year-over-year growth, providing an additional contribution to telecom service revenue.


Notably, to further enrich our telecom service offerings and expand AI-enabled use cases, we announced the strengthened partnership with Google by introducing a broader range of Google AI offerings to match with our mobile and broadband services, such as Google Pixel, YouTube Premium, and Google AI applications. We aim to accelerate consumer AI adoption, expand our telecom service value, and create new growth opportunities.


ICT revenue surged 39.9% year over year in October, driven by revenue recognition from the completion of large-scale IDC projects, delivery of a grid energy storage system project, and completion of overseas factory construction projects for


Taiwanese enterprises. These contributions resulted in exceeding 50% year-over-year revenue growth in both IDC and cloud services and AIOT business, reflecting expanding demand for AI applications and next-generation digital infrastructure in Taiwan and overseas. The strong performance also demonstrates CHT’s robust service capabilities and competitive advantages in the ICT market, making ICT an increasingly important contributor to the Group’s growth.


As of October 2026, the accumulated unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$212.69 billion. Operating income was NT$46.40 billion and income before tax was NT$47.40 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent was NT$36.56 billion and EPS was NT$4.71. Revenue, operating income, income before tax, net income attributable to stockholders of the parent and EPS all exceeded guidance.

**About Chunghwa Telecom**


Chunghwa Telecom (TAIEX 2412, NYSE: CHT) (“Chunghwa” or “the Company”) is Taiwan’s largest integrated telecommunications services company that provides fixed-line, mobile, broadband, and internet services. The Company also provides information and communication technology services to corporate customers with its big data, information security, cloud computing and IDC capabilities, and is expanding its business into innovative technology services such as IoT, AI, etc. Chunghwa has been actively and continuously implemented environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives with the goal to achieve sustainability and has won numerous international and domestic awards and recognitions for its ESG commitments and best practices. For more information, please visit our website at www.cht.com.tw
